subject.title: Add read-only workspace file browser to Android app

question: Should workspace file content reads for the mobile browser be exposed through this PR's `operator.read` `agents.workspace.read` RPC, or should maintainers require the protected split-stack API with a higher or dedicated content-read scope before any mobile clients merge?
rationale: The code repair is straightforward only after maintainers decide whether ordinary read-scoped operator clients may read arbitrary in-workspace file previews.

options.title: Gate And Align Before Merge
options.body: Require a higher or dedicated approved file-read scope, align the method contract with the protected Gateway PR, and update tests/docs/mobile clients before merge.

options.title: Accept Read-Scope Browsing
options.body: Proceed with ordinary `operator.read` content access only if security owners explicitly accept that existing non-admin operator clients may preview and share workspace files.

options.title: Pause For Split Stack
options.body: Keep this PR open or pause it while #100738, #100767, and #100776 settle the Gateway, iOS, and Android surfaces separately.

recommendation.title: Gate And Align Before Merge
recommendation.body: Require a higher or dedicated approved file-read scope, align the method contract with the protected Gateway PR, and update tests/docs/mobile clients before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature request and own the active split-stack implementation path that needs the authorization decision.
